response: I'm sorry for the trouble importing your CRM data. Please ensure your CSV is UTF-8 encoded and all special characters are properly escaped, as these formatting issues often trigger 'invalid format' errors.

To restrict your interns, assign them the 'Member' role and create a 'Standard User' permission group with delete permissions disabled (KB-1055). Manage project visibility via Team Permissions and consider using Workspace Blueprints (Settings > Workspace > Blueprints) to automate this setup (KB-1095).
You can find comprehensive rate limiting details at docs.steadfast.io/api. I also recommend reviewing our 'Getting Started with the API' tutorial (KB-1050) for additional setup guidance.

For your Trello migration, we recommend using our CSV import tool or the API for full fidelity as outlined in KB-1015. We support mapping up to 20 custom fields and can schedule a migration assistance session to ensure your labels and attachments transfer correctly.

I'm sorry for the inconsistent webhook triggers. This typically stems from the 30-day TTL on unauthenticated webhooks; please switch to our authenticated webhook option with an API key in the header to ensure reliable delivery.

I'm sorry for the performance issues affecting your 100-person team. Our engineers are investigating potential database query bottlenecks related to custom field filters and will look into enabling CDN caching for your workspace to restore speed.

I understand you'd like notifications to show the specific user. Please reconfigure your Slack integration to ensure it uses the latest ID-based mapping, as we recently updated our connector to resolve metadata more accurately.
I apologize for the blank billing page. We are checking if our PDF rendering service (wkhtmltopdf) requires a font package reinstall and service restart to restore your invoice access.

We are investigating this redirect loop, which may be caused by a session cookie conflict or a SAML assertion race condition. Please verify your certificate in Admin > Security > SSO while we work on adjusting your cookie domain scope and callback URL parameters.

I’m sorry for the lag your 150 users are experiencing during peak hours. We are investigating potential database bottlenecks and will look into enabling CDN caching or adding indexes to your custom field filters to restore performance.

It sounds like your automation might be triggering on status changes rather than due dates. Please navigate to Settings > Notifications > Due Date Reminders to select the specific 'overdue' option, or check your individual project settings.

I have confirmed all active sessions for the user are terminated. To audit their activity, navigate to Admin > Reports > User Access Report to export a CSV of their access history, as outlined in KB-2015.
I apologize for the duplicate $1,680 charge caused by a Stripe webhook error (ENG-4502). I am processing your refund now and will provide a reference ID once confirmed.

MFA enforcement is available for your Enterprise workspace within Settings > Workspace to ensure all users are forced to complete setup upon their next login. For detailed walkthroughs, please visit the Steadfast Academy (academy.steadfast.io).
I’m sorry your dashboard is failing. We recently deployed version 3.14.3 to fix dashboard data aggregation issues; please refresh your browser to ensure you have the latest hotfix.

I’ve attached our Enterprise pricing sheet (v2024-Q4), which offers a $38/seat/month rate for 500+ seats and includes a 99.95% SLA and dedicated CSM. I am looping in Sarah K. from our sales team to discuss your migration and implementation timeline.

Thank you for suggesting color-coded labels to improve board view scannability. While our recent v3.14.3 update focused on resolving board interaction issues, I have shared your request for visual category distinctions with our product team for future consideration.

I will verify your billing profile linking to resolve any synchronization mismatches, similar to EIN linking errors. I am also resending your last three invoices to finance@quartz-data.com immediately.

I can help you configure SCIM provisioning with Okta. Similar to our Jira integration, you'll need to install the Steadfast app in Okta, configure attribute mappings, and enable sync rules for your Enterprise account.

I'm sorry for the timeouts on your large project views. This typically indicates a database query bottleneck with custom field filters; we are escalating this to apply specific indexing and enable CDN caching for your workspace to restore performance.

I have logged your request for task dependencies with our product team. While this isn't currently available, you can use Zapier as a bridge to automate task updates or reference our API documentation to build a custom solution.

I’m sorry your dropdown options aren't saving; our team is investigating if this is a field serialization issue similar to the custom status mapping fix in v3.14.2. I’ll notify you immediately once a fix is deployed.

To transfer ownership, please submit a written request from a company officer using our authorization form and complete domain verification. We will then transfer the role, deactivate your account, and regenerate API keys as a security precaution.

I can help clarify our Growth plan seat billing policy. While billing is prorated for your first month, subsequent cycles are full charges on the 1st; I'll review your invoice breakdown and investigate if a credit is applicable for the inactive seats.

Upon cancellation, your archived projects remain accessible in a read-only state, though limits apply to custom fields and active integrations. We recommend performing a full data export before finalizing any changes to ensure you have a complete backup.

I am sorry to hear your deliverables are disappearing. We are investigating our upload proxy and the 50MB file size limit to see if a configuration error is causing these deletions. I will provide an update from our engineering team immediately.

I have initiated a security audit to track any accessed information. Please verify your identity via your account's security questions so we can terminate the unrecognized session; we also strongly recommend enabling SSO to enhance your account security.

I'm sorry for the disruption to your analytics dashboard. While the Growth plan limit is 100 req/min, we're investigating if a backend migration affected this endpoint and have requested a temporary rate limit bump to 200 req/min to restore service.
I'm sorry for the search inconsistencies. Our team will investigate your Elasticsearch index and may perform a reindex job to ensure your results are consistent and correctly synced.

Welcome! Please follow our Admin Onboarding Checklist (KB-1001), starting with workspace settings and project templates before inviting a pilot group. We also offer a free onboarding call with our CS team to help structure your campaigns.
